scope: Voxy/Sodium design candidates; synthetic component A/B, not live game FPS
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER; NVIDIA 572.70; OpenGL 4.6

method.cpu_time: prepare and submit, excluding glFinish and synchronous query readback
method.baseline: exact beginning-of-turn dirty worktree snapshots; not Git HEAD

decisions.guard: keep seams, morph, unknown and double-sided; reject <12.5% quad reduction or >max(4,2*input_ranges) fragments

decisions.candidate: water sorting triggered by X/Z only
decisions.guard: ownership, GPU residency and geometry revisions still invalidate; horizontal ordering unchanged

decisions.candidate: 2x2 local terrain LOD with exact joining rings
decisions.reason: tested implementation increased quads, commands, storage, build and GPU cost
GPU faster but filled layered gaps, added occupancy and lost minority materials

limitations: No whole-game FPS, P95 or P99 comparison was performed.
Repeating synthetic geometry amplifies component cost; it is not a captured current scene.
Local terrain selection uses assumed projection scale/depth, not the full live perspective selector.
Canopy worker values are single diagnostic samples, not repeated worker A/B.
Latest NeoForge candidate GPU XML contains only the water rerun; earlier direction/representation CSVs remain.
Conditional upload estimation, page relocation and bamboo caching were not implemented without hotspot evidence.
